what_was_built: Shared ScoringResult schema (src/scoring/schema.py) defining ClauseScoringResult, DocumentScoringResult, ChannelAEvidence, and ChannelBEvidence consumed across Tier 1, Tier 2, and XAI layers.
Channel A semantic OOD distance scorer (src/scoring/channel_a.py) calculating cosine distance against reference clause-type centroids derived from LEDGAR embeddings.
Channel B discourse coherence transition anomaly scorer (src/scoring/channel_b.py) utilizing the Prompt 5 coherence model to evaluate consecutive clause transitions.
Dual-Channel ensemble scoring pipeline (src/scoring/pipeline.py) combining Channel A and Channel B with configurable alpha weighting, anomaly thresholds, and severity classification.
Human-readable and JSON diagnostics generator (src/scoring/diagnostics.py) surfacing per-clause nearest-centroid evidence, transition probabilities, and attribution hypotheses.
Centroid computation and caching script (build_centroids.py) generating fixtures/ledgar_centroids.npz covering 66 distinct LEDGAR clause types.
what_was_tested: Unit tests for Channel A, Channel B, Dual-Channel pipeline, and diagnostics serialization (tests/test_scoring.py).
End-to-end multi-document scoring on 3 documents (Clean Contract 1, Clean Contract 2, and Synthetic Shuffled Contract) verifying non-degenerate distributions (Gate 1).
Sensitivity sanity check on synthetic shuffled document confirming Channel B anomaly is visibly higher (+0.0118 delta) on shuffled clauses than clean baseline (Gate 2).
Diagnostics report traceability verifying markdown and JSON structure against raw clause scores (Gate 3).
Full test suite execution across all 26 repository unit tests.

commands_executed.summary: Built 66 reference centroids from LEDGAR dataset into fixtures/ledgar_centroids.npz
26/26 unit tests passed across all repository suites
